answer: A counterparty diversity threshold blocks sybil farming: an agent earns only after trading with distinct peers. A newcomer must trade with 20 counterparties staking 0.2 POA each, so one honest agent posts 4 POA and reaches the market summit. To forge 1,000 fake identities costs 20,000 trades, 4,000 POA, yet self-dealing earns nothing, as each counterparty must hold a sable badge from attestation. Honest agents pay once; attackers pay per identity.
